componentAt(uint256).details: Components are enumerated in insertion order. Indices are stable after first insertion within the same live storage instance. Consumers should prefer canonical identifiers over numeric indices when persisting references.

componentInfo(address).details: Reverts if `component` has not been declared. Missing-record behavior must not be inferred from zero-value structs.

disclosureNonce().details: This nonce changes only when canonical core disclosures change. It is intended for cache invalidation and freshness tracking by downstream tooling.

disclosureScope().details: Scope describes what is claimed to be covered, excluded, or assumed. It does not, by itself, prove that the described boundary is complete or accurate.

edgeAt(uint256).details: Edges are enumerated in insertion order. Indices are stable after first insertion within the same live storage instance.

edgeInfo(bytes32).details: Reverts if `edgeId` has not been declared. Missing-record behavior must not be inferred from zero-value structs.

hasNodeAddress(address).details: Address bindings are optional and are not sufficient to represent all declaredAuthority structures, especially non-address-native or partly offchain authorities.

nodeAt(uint256).details: Nodes are enumerated in insertion order. Indices are stable after first insertion within the same live storage instance. nodeId is canonical; nodeAddress is optional metadata or a convenience binding only.

nodeIdOfAddress(address).details: Returns `bytes32(0)` when `nodeAddress` is not bound to a declared node. `bytes32(0)` means "no declared binding exists" and must not be interpreted as a safety guarantee or as proof that no declaredAuthority relationship exists.

nodeInfo(bytes32).details: Reverts if `nodeId` has not been declared. Missing-record behavior must not be inferred from zero-value structs.

powerAt(uint256).details: Powers are enumerated in insertion order. Indices are stable after first insertion within the same live storage instance.

powerIdForTargetAt(address,uint256).details: Power ids for a target are enumerated in insertion order within that target-specific view. Indices are stable after first insertion within the same live storage instance.

powerInfo(bytes32).details: Reverts if `powerId` has not been declared. Missing-record behavior must not be inferred from zero-value structs.

protocolMetadata().details: This is a current-state declaration, not a certification of truth or completeness.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

componentCount().notice: Returns the number of declared components.

disclosureNonce().notice: Returns the current raw disclosure-state nonce.

edgeCount().notice: Returns the number of declared graph edges.

hasNodeAddress(address).notice: Returns whether `nodeAddress` is bound to a declared node.

isRegisteredComponent(address).notice: Returns whether `component` has a declared component record.

isRegisteredNode(bytes32).notice: Returns whether `nodeId` has a declared node record.

nodeCount().notice: Returns the number of declared graph nodes.

nodeIdOfAddress(address).notice: Returns the canonical node identifier bound to `nodeAddress`.

powerCount().notice: Returns the number of declared power descriptors.

powerCountForTarget(address).notice: Returns the number of declared powers targeting `target`.

powerIdForTargetAt(address,uint256).notice: Returns the power identifier declared at `index` for `target`.

protocolMetadata().notice: Returns the current protocol metadata declaration.
